features.scope: Plain headings and escaped literals, paragraphs with nested marks, and source mapping for proof, abstract and nested lists. Browser checks cover editing marked text alongside inline math, including inside a proof. Prose paste and direct typing preserve supported escaped characters, and LuaLaTeX reports a native glyph for the escaped caret. More text environments remain pending.

The browser gates cover empty and nonempty cells, mixed marked text and math in tabularx, and inserting rows and columns with exact source writeback and undo. Multicolumn and multirow range mapping has direct tests. The real engine reports an empty-cell anchor, marked cell glyphs and an inline formula field with unchanged page drawing on both platforms. Broader table structure and cell styling commands remain pending.

Included prose and display math edit the owning source file. The native exit shortcut resumes typing in the parent. Cross-file copying can include complete display formulas. Adjacent paragraphs support cross-file replacement and undo, including complete inline formulas and surviving marked text. Independent documents switch the compilation entry. Detached fragments inherit the preamble and keep their original source offsets. Folding preserves original page numbering and partial edge placeholders. The browser gate also verifies that folding an include that shares a line with the parent only masks its own measured horizontal span. Actual LuaLaTeX tests confirm that edits to a staged child retain both the live and geometry-observation sessions. Broader structural edits and geometry with overlapping owners remain pending.

Real staged PNG drawing metadata is unchanged by ownership. Browser gates select a raster from Canvas and a transformed raster in a simulated registered PDF frame, then patch its width through the Image controls. A direct click on standalone TikZ in a registered real LuaLaTeX PDF opens the visual editor on Windows and macOS. The native workspace can select an exact opaque block in Source. Nested figure content remains pending.

A registered PDF with matching page dimensions and ownership supports semantic editing. Native geometry from a real two-platform LuaLaTeX run provides browser evidence for opening standalone TikZ for editing and updating a nearby formula. Mismatched dimensions disable editing. More complex page objects remain pending.

The native command palette covers verified math structures and the status bar displays the active nested field. Formula label changes preserve the selected equation or alignment row and its surroundings. Keyboard commands insert inline and numbered display formulas, accept an initial display formula in a blank document, and leave a nested fraction with Ctrl+J. The prose palette inserts an exact page break, edits document metadata, and offers project input and include commands.

Copy, cut, formatted paste, whole inline formula selection, synthetic Chinese composition, and queued input during a forced geometry delay. Verified selections within one paragraph copy formatting alongside plain text, and native math accepts validated LaTeX fragments from the clipboard. Browser checks cover vertical caret and page navigation, the textarea anchor during scrolling, and the first preedit after exiting inline math. Physical input methods and broader cross-file editing remain pending.

The opt-in desktop workspace uses the same native engine session across Document, Source and the read-only Split preview. Source edits reach the same session without rasterizing hidden pages. Browser tests verify that the old paginator and MathLive do not load. Full coverage and physical device checks are required before making this the default.

legacyDisabled.scope: Two-platform Chromium with legacy pagination and MathLive disabled. Mixed prose and display formula edit, undo/redo, root insertion, exact source bytes, plain bold prose, table cells, headings, and synthetic IME. Real LuaLaTeX geometry is replayed in a separate browser gate with a simulated transport.

desktopWebView.scope: GitHub-hosted WebView2 and WKWebView start with legacy pagination and MathLive disabled. The embedded font, PDF worker, and native IPC are checked. Physical key delivery, candidate placement and display scan-out remain separate acceptance items.
